GOV-F-003-S156.title: Brain Lock Schema and TTL Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S156.description: Define and persist the lock schema including owner_id, acquired_at, ttl_seconds, last_heartbeat_at, and status. Establish strict contract for TTL interpretation and expiration semantics across all Brain components.

GOV-F-003-S157.title: Lock Acquire/Renew API Contract
GOV-F-003-S157.description: Implement standardized internal APIs for acquiring, renewing (heartbeat), and releasing Brain locks with TTL enforcement. Ensure consistent responses for success, contention, and expired lock takeover.

GOV-F-003-S158.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock TTL Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S158.description: Integrate TTL-based lock acquisition, heartbeat renewal, and recovery into brain_runner execution flow to ensure safe single-writer behavior during assignment processing.

GOV-F-003-S159.title: Administrative Lock Inspection and Manual Recovery Endpoint
GOV-F-003-S159.description: Provide a controlled administrative mechanism to inspect current lock state and trigger manual recovery/unlock in failure scenarios, aligned with existing safety/admin patterns.
